verdict.rationale: MailerLite's own API offers a batch endpoint that bundles up to 50 API calls into one request. It also offers a bulk-import endpoint for shop customers, products, categories and orders in a single request, so bulk operations across many items are a first-party capability. Missing for 10: detail on which operations batching supports and how errors are handled, bulk operations on subscribers/campaigns beyond e-commerce import, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Bundle up to 50 API calls into a single batch request to stay within MailerLite's rate limits.
Bulk-import shop data — customers, products, categories, and orders — into MailerLite in a single request.
